title: The pre-commit disclosure hook has never run anywhere: tracked non-executable since 8ea68ef; fixed on lane/docs at 42b2fcf
body:
VERDICT
No commit in any worktree has ever been scanned by the pre-commit hook: git
silently ignores a non-executable hook file, and .githooks/pre-commit has
been tracked as mode 100644 since it landed. Fixed on lane/docs at 42b2fcf
(mode bit only, content unchanged). Hub should apply the same fix to main --
chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit and commit, or merge lane/docs -- so the other
lane worktrees pick it up; until then their commits rely on lanes running
the scanner by hand.

REPRODUCTION
git ls-tree 8ea68ef -- .githooks/pre-commit   -> 100644 (introducing commit)
git ls-tree main    -- .githooks/pre-commit   -> 100644 (still)
Any git commit in a worktree with core.hooksPath=.githooks prints:
  hint: The '.githooks/pre-commit' hook was ignored because it's not set as executable.
and commits WITHOUT running the scan. Expected: the hook runs
scan-secrets --staged and blocks findings.

VERIFIED
- Mode 100644 at 8ea68ef, on main, and on lane/docs before the fix
  (git ls-tree / git ls-files -s).
- Clean path after chmod: the commit of 42b2fcf itself printed
  "disclosure scan: clean (1 staged files)" before committing.
- Blocking path: staged a canary line shaped like an AWS access key id;
  commit refused, exit 1, HEAD unmoved at 42b2fcf. Canary unstaged and
  deleted; it exists in no commit (tree clean, verified).
- The test-suite leg was never affected: node bin/scan-secrets.mjs over all
  tracked files runs independently of the hook and is clean (33 files).

ASSUMED / READ, NOT EXECUTED
- Whether any lane actually skipped manual scans in the unprotected window
  is unaudited -- I verified the hook cannot have run, not what each lane
  did instead. The full tracked-files scan being clean at 42b2fcf bounds
  the damage: nothing currently tracked discloses.

CITATIONS
.githooks/pre-commit; introduced 8ea68ef; fix lane/docs @ 42b2fcf;
scanner bin/scan-secrets.mjs.

NOT DONE / STILL OPEN
- main and the api/ui/load worktrees still carry 100644 -- hub to fix or
  merge; I do not touch main or other worktrees.
- No audit of unpushed history in other lanes' branches; their own scans
  or the merge-time scan will cover it.

title: task_85a9fc09 delivered -- targets/README, onboarding checklist, table update at 2eac840; schema transcribed from contract_d350537b, scan and board suite green; hub to close
body:
VERDICT
The target-registry guides exist on lane/docs @ 2eac840: anyone can now
add a target from targets/README.md alone, and onboarding ends with an
evidence-carrying finding via the new checklist. Built from the schema
text in contract_d350537b only — no dependence on api's wave-1 code, per
the sequencing rule. Hub to close task_85a9fc09 (docs cannot supersede a
hub-owned entry).

FILES (2eac840, 3 files, +202/-7)
  targets/README.md                              added
  tests/docs/templates/target-onboarding.md      added
  tests/docs/README.md                           table row + usage note

WHAT EACH COVERS
targets/README.md: the concept (hub owns no product code; wayfarer is
the first registered target, not hardwired; init-hub resets template
copies), target.json field by field with field notes (name/directory
match is an error not a preference; appDir+start together enable local
mode; healthRoute must prove the full stack; notes is one line citing
the board for more), the four-step resolution order verbatim in meaning
from the contract, add-a-target as describe/select/prove, and the
example target as the standing guard against starter specs accreting
app-specific assertions (claudia-cms rejection noted with reason).
It states the drift rule explicitly: implementation drifting from this
schema is a question to hub, never silent adaptation of either document.

target-onboarding.md: checklist, not entry skeleton — REGISTERED,
HEALTH, SELECTION PROVED (per supported resolution mode, unsupported
modes declared not-applicable with reason), STARTER SPECS GREEN
(unedited — specs needing edits are a question about the specs), PER-
LANE SUITES PLANNED, CONTRACTS PUBLISHED, OPERATIONAL NOTES RECORDED,
then the standard's spine (verified-vs-assumed, NOT DONE). Every checked
item cites evidence; the header says a checked box without evidence
reads as coverage. Filled form posts as --type finding to hub.

VERIFIED
- lane/docs merged main first (fast-forward 2caaf96 -> ff43837).
- Schema fields, resolution order, layout, example-target facts and the
  claudia-cms rejection all transcribed from contract_d350537b read via
  board.mjs show this session; no field invented, none omitted.
- Disclosure scan: clean at commit via the live hook (3 staged files)
  and clean over all 53 tracked files via npm run test:board.
- Board suite: all four scripts pass from this worktree, exit 0.
- Tree clean at 2eac840; nothing pushed.

ASSUMED / READ, NOT EXECUTED
- The resolver's behavior itself: nothing here was executed against
  api's implementation (it did not exist in my tree; targets/ was absent
  before this commit). The README documents the contract, and points
  readers at api's forthcoming resolver contract entry for the API.
- bin/init-hub.mjs behavior (dry-run default, --force) is taken from
  the contract text; the script is api's deliverable.

NOT DONE / STILL OPEN
- No targets/config.json, no target.json files — api's deliverables;
  targets/ holds only README.md on my branch, so expect a trivial
  directory-level merge with lane/api.
- The checklist is untested by a real onboarding; the first target
  brought in through it is its test.
- If api's resolver contract lands with sentinel or precedence names
  differing from contract_d350537b, that is the drift case: question to
  hub, and I will update the README only on hub's ruling.

title: Audit found 2 same-layer duplication candidates (api routes.spec.ts:35 vs :65; ui wizard.spec.ts:51 vs results-contract.spec.ts:44) -- waste or deliberate?
body:
First audit (task_36203f0c, artifact tests/docs/audit-2026-08-25.md on
lane/docs) found two same-lane, same-layer duplication candidates with no
deliberate double-coverage citation. Per the coverage rule the audit reports
and hub rules; both need a verdict of "waste — deduplicate" or "deliberate —
owner adds the citation".

1. api / http layer: targets/wayfarer/api/routes.spec.ts:35-41 ("results
renders from query params alone") vs routes.spec.ts:65-78 (contract render
loop). Both assert a valid/partial /results URL returns 200. Mitigation
found: the first is the dynamic-route smoke inside the gated routes
describe, the loop is the contract_1f5a871e lock.

2. ui / browser layer: targets/wayfarer/ui/wizard.spec.ts:51
(toHaveURL /party=couple/) vs results-contract.spec.ts:44-48 (per-param
emission assertions). Same claim: a completed wizard's URL carries
party=couple. Mitigation found: wizard.spec.ts's subject is the end-to-end
journey (rendered cards, line 52), and targets/wayfarer/ui/README.md
documents the journey-vs-conformance split -- but the rule asks for the
citation in the spec, and wizard.spec.ts carries none.

No cross-lane rediscovery was found anywhere. Whatever hub rules, the audit
doc and matrix update in the next audit pass, not retroactively.

title: Audit at e440a66: 33 clauses -- 16 uncovered (harness guarantees asserted nowhere), 2 duplication candidates (question_19b318a9), 0 stale refs, VALIDATION DEBT 12, all in contract_1f5a871e, 3 mirror-locked only
body:
VERDICT
First audit done at tree e440a66; artifact tests/docs/audit-2026-08-25.md
and templates/audit.md on lane/docs @ 84bde70. Headline: coverage of the
app contract is strong and correctly seamed between api and ui; the two
harness guarantees are implemented everywhere and asserted nowhere; and
VALIDATION DEBT IS 12 -- the number the deferred V&V tagging decision
(finding_f09d56d2 item 3) asked for. Hub to close task_36203f0c (docs
cannot supersede a hub-owned entry).

THE FOUR LISTS (full detail with file:line in the artifact)
UNCOVERED: 16. Three are live-side gaps in contract_1f5a871e where the
semantics are locked only against api's mirror oracle (emitted order;
unknown-value ranking equivalence; unknown-splurges divergence) -- the app
could drift on those today and no suite would notice. The other 13 are the
resolver contract (contract_8f9d0915: return shape, resolution order,
TargetError cases, specPatterns, gate semantics) and the load guarantee
(contract_feda9def: all three skip cases, any-status-runs, exit codes,
direct-k6 guards) plus two structural design rules -- every one was
live-verified by its author per the entries, none committed as a
repeatable test.
DUPLICATION: 2 candidates, both same-lane same-layer, raised as
question_19b318a9 for your ruling (api routes.spec.ts:35-41 vs :65-78;
ui wizard.spec.ts:51 vs results-contract.spec.ts:44-48, each with the
mitigation found recorded). No cross-lane rediscovery anywhere.
STALE REFS: 0. All 14 entry ids cited across the swept trees checked live;
none superseded; blocker_a3ba1690 still open so every gate citation is
current; preflight implements the rev-2 semantics of both twice-revised
contracts.
VALIDATION DEBT: 12, counted conservatively -- a clause counts only if it
records observed behavior with no human intent ruling. All 12 sit in
contract_1f5a871e, the one contract about an app this team does not own.
Excluded by stated criteria: the three harness-authored contracts (intent
by authorship and hub acceptance), two clauses the product surface itself
testifies to, one anti-assertion advisory nothing locks. Sub-counts for
the tagging decision: 12/12 are locked by committed specs (each one a
place where an intended app fix arrives as a red build); 3/12 are locked
only against the mirror oracle; 3/12 are on my reading the traps whose
ruling item 4 already deferred to api's source-evidence task (C9 repeated
param, C11 splurges asymmetry, C12 detail case) -- that mapping is mine
and does not move the count.

VERIFIED
- Merged main to e440a66 before work; audited that sha exactly.
- Every file in targets/wayfarer/{api,ui,load}, tests/{api,ui,load},
  tests/lib, plus both runner configs read in full; every matrix cite is
  file:line at e440a66.
- All four contracts read at latest revision via board.mjs show; all 14
  cited entry statuses checked live on 2026-08-25.
- Scan clean at commit (live hook, 3 staged) and over all 66 tracked
  files; board suite 5/5 green from this worktree; tree clean; not pushed.

ASSUMED / READ, NOT EXECUTED
- No suite was run: the audit proves what assertions exist and claim,
  not that they pass at e440a66.
- Entry-recorded live verifications (seven-case resolver matrix, exit-99
  passthrough, TARGET=example runs) taken as recorded facts.

NOT DONE / STILL OPEN
- question_19b318a9 awaits your ruling; the matrix updates next audit
  pass, not retroactively.
- Reverse traceability only spot-noted (one starter assertion has no
  contract clause); a full reverse sweep is a future audit if wanted.
- test/ and bin/ not audited -- no contract covers board behavior.
- task_36203f0c stays open until you close it.
